notes.title: Upcoming Changes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

You may or may not have noticed some small changes happening to the store page and social media for the game. I just wanted to confirm that the game is back under development after being on hiatus for a little while and that it will be undergoing some changes.

[h2]New Faces[/h2]
First off, an introduction is an order. This is Toby Davis (Digivorix) writing the words you are reading on screen right now! I've been working with Pablo (ExpoDev) on the project recently and we are cooking up some things that we think you will really like, with one of them being improved support for Steam Deck. There will also be changes coming to the game's campaign that will be detailed once a little more work has been done.

[h2]New Names[/h2]
You may have also noticed that Imperfect Studios is no longer the publisher for this game. This is due to Pablo and I forming a new brand name to publish this game under. Indie Brain Games will be the label for any of our collaborative projects going forward as well.

[h2]New Engine (but not really)[/h2]
For those of you who saw that the TeamJumpers Twitter account was using the #MadeWithUnity hashtag for a while, I can now confirm that the game's has switched back to it's original Clickteam Fusion 2.5 engine.

More details will be available soon, so keep an eye out for an upcoming announcement along with some more store page changes.

And of course a big thanks to Pablo for letting me work on this project with him!

Sincerely,
-Toby "Digivorix" Davis

notes.title: Roadmap #1
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone! 

I hope you are all doing well! This is our first official roadmap where we are going to announce some upcoming updates to the game!

The first one is some adjustments to the Jump anticipation and delay when Jumping[/h1]

[img]https://media1.giphy.com/media/bAE9PkMyEIvebso48E/giphy.gif?cid=790b76110534558546167be36693f55d3573fc076be3acf5&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]

[h1]Before, it would occur where you would sometimes miss a jump due to the anticipation animation taking too long to play causing a jump to take longer to proceed with,

Now, in the next update, you will be able to make jumps much quicker!

[i][b]What else did we add?[/b][/i]

We are adding knockback to the enemies so that when you hit them, it deals not only damage to the enemies of every dimension, but they will now be knocked back! 
[/h1]

[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/pwTCsDKnJKzGA3ZP7j/giphy.gif?cid=790b7611f98ba24e7bdfaa327d3cec01b5a94c48501700d3&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]

[h1]YOU CAN NOW KNOCK ANY FOES INTO THE VOID!!!

On top of that, we'll also be fixing as many bugs as we can spot, and we'll also be adjusting our UI system...

Keep on the lookout for this, but if you want to contribute to the development of the game, feel free to do so by reporting bugs and giving feedback on [url=https://forms.gle/m87d9Z7t6m3CinGj7]this form[/url]...

[/h1]

[h1]We have some other stuff planned that we Do not want to spoil, but we're very excited to reveal what comes next for TeamJumpers!

As always thank you for playing![/h1]

notes.title: A little update on development and life...
notes.content:
[h2]Hi everyone, I hope everyone is doing well...

First off I just wanted to say, bits and pieces of this update are copy+pasted from my Twitter thread I did talking about this, but I wanted to shed some light on the game itself as well as some things going on in my life right now.

So I’ll be moving somewhere completely brand new soon and with school starting up, I'll be moving schools along with taking care of some other stuff in life, I just need to take a small hiatus from TeamJumpers 2 and making content at the moment, I’m not leaving, I’m just stepping back for a bit so I can focus on moving, getting settled, and overall adjusting to changes in my life… I hope you all understand, I may be active here and there online and on YouTube, Twitter, and discord and such but I can’t guarantee anything, but don't worry, I’ll be back at it before you know it :)

As for the game itself goes...

As some of you may know the Kickstarter goal was not met and that's ok. We will continue to develop the game and make it the best it can be up to launch day and beyond!

We have big plans in the works!

We will try and get this game out this year but I honestly, can't guarantee a 2021 launch this year... 

Does this mean I'm officially delaying the game to early-mid 2022?

not quite...

I'm more leaving myself open to the idea of doing so in the event that the game needs more time to be complete.

I'll keep you guys posted on this...[/h2]

notes.title: Development Updates & Kickstarter Announcement!
notes.content:
[h1]As some of you may have noticed, The game's art style has changed if you've looked at the game's Steam page recently or any recent media for the game on Twitter, YouTube, or Discord.

I wanted to announce that I have been working closely with some very talented people to completely rework the game and make it a lot better! The game will now feature brand new mechanics, brand new level design, brand new enemies, and completely reimagined bosses! 

Allow me to introduce those new people![/h1]

[h1]On the technical side of things, I've been working with Cesar Fernandes or 'Naitor Studios' on Reworking the entire game, and creating the best possible experience for you guys to play! We've been working closely together to create what is becoming more and more of the ideal sequel! We have big things planned and we can't wait to show them off![/h1]

[h1]As for art, we have a new artist named Fire's Illustration, he has done some incredible artwork and his portfolio can be found [url=https://sites.google.com/view/fipixelartportfolio/home?authuser=0]here[/url]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8fdJ4b8.jpg[/img]

As for other news, we have a [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/imperfectstudios/teamjumpers-2-new-reality]kickstarter![/url]

[h2]The Stretch Goals Are As Follows [/h2]

[h1]Future Stretch Goals 

$100 - Color Customization 

Change the color of your player to a custom color instead of the standard green and red player colors!

$500 - Hats! 

Unlock multiple different hats to choose from (only cosmetic)

$1000 - Collectibles 

Collectible items for different levels to show you went the extra mile!

$1,500 - Custom Drawable Faces for the players 

Change the look of the player's face by drawing it yourself!

$2,000 - More weapons to choose from

More weapons based on community polls of what people want.

$2,500 - Puzzle Levels

We will add more puzzle-based levels into the game!

$3,000 - Add PvP battle arena for up to four players 

Duke it out with up to four players online or in local multiplayer! Only one winner/team will remain victorious!

$3,500 - Mobile ports! (Android/iOS) 

Play the game on the go! Keep it in your pocket!

$4,000 - Add an additional bonus reality to travel to! 

We will add an additional Bonus reality for you to explore after the main campaign!

$4,500 - Level editor with steam workshop support for creating and sharing your levels with the community!

Create and share your levels with other people in the steam workshop community![/h1]

And finally, we have a new trailer for you guys!
[previewyoutube=IdhDa_dsTvQ;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

That's all I have to say for now but thank you all so much for the support this game has been getting! :)
[/h1]

notes.title: Official Discord Server, Official Website and development progress!
notes.content:
I just wanted to update you all with some news regarding the second game. We have been hard at work as a dev team creating what I think is a huge step up from the first game! It's cool! It's exciting! And it's a lot of fun to play as well ;)

With all that being said, development is taking a long time! We are still fixing major bugs and making changes to the inside out, we haven't even started on the Other worlds yet, so we need a lot more time to work on this, and no, I'm not delaying the game, and the release date currently showing on the steam page is more of a placeholder release date because I had to put something there. Please trust that this is going to be a lot better this time around!

Anyways so we have a website and discord server you can join now... :)

Discord Link - 
https://discord.gg/HNbSzGVA2f

Website Link - 
https://pabloheckman.wix.com/teamjumpers2

I hope you guys are all having a nice day/evening, and I will try to share some more info soon as we progress in development. The most you'll probably see are teasers, concept art, or snippets of music here and there.

Thanks so much for playing! It means a ton :)
